text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: One day, Mari was passing through the park when she saw Iroha and Sono playing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ある日、
真璃が公園を通りがかると、
いろはと苑が遊んでいる姿が目に入った。

text_block_list.name: Mari
text_block_list.text: ...Oh my, that's the neighbors. Iroha-chan, Sono-san, hell-~...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あら、
あれはお隣の。
いろはちゃん、
苑さん、
こんにち──

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Thump!
text_block_list.orig_text: ゴツンッ！

text_block_list.name: Mari
text_block_list.text: Eeeh, they bumped into each other!? Are you okay...!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ、
ぶつかった！？
大丈夫ですか……！？

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Ouch.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うう……
いたた。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Hey, Iroha! Don't just run around aimlessly! That's dangerous...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっといろは！
あんた謎に走りまわるんじゃないわよ
危ないなー……！

text_block_list.name: Mari
text_block_list.text: ... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, sorry, Sono-chan! Please forgive me, samurai style!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ、
ごめんね苑ちゃん！
許してちょんまげーっ！！

text_block_list.name: Mari
text_block_list.text: Wha-... what's going on here...?! Could it be that they swapped bodies when they bumped into each other...? No, no, how'd that be even possible?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょ、
どういうこと……！？
もしかして
ぶつかった拍子で入れ替わっちゃったとか……
いやいや
そんなことあるわけないわよね！？

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Geez, Iroha. Naughty children get their butts spanked, you know.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もういろは。
悪い子はお尻ぺんぺんだよ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I'm sorry for always being like this. Iroha will be a good girl so that Sono-chan won't get mad at her.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん……
いつもごめんなさい。
いろは、
苑ちゃんに怒られないようないい子になるね。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Y-Yeah, that's right. That'll be fine.
text_block_list.orig_text:
え……？
う、
うん
そうよ。
それでいいのよ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Iroha's going to help out a lot around the house from now on! I'll study hard and do my best in school clubs too! I won't be picky about food and I'll give Sono-chan a shoulder massage every day!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いろは
これからはお家のお手伝いもいっぱいするね！
お勉強も頑張るし、
クラブも頑張る！
食べ物の好き嫌いもしないし、
毎日苑ちゃんの肩たたきもしよー
っと！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: ...!? Iroha wouldn't do such thin-...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っ！？
いろはそんなことしない……

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: ...In that case... Ehehe...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
それなら……
えへへ……っ。

text_block_list.name: いろは
text_block_list.text:
むむ……
あたしゃ老眼で目がしょぼしょぼじゃよ～
text_block_list.orig_text:
むむ……
あたしゃ老眼で目がしょぼしょぼじゃよ～

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Eeek... My shoulders are so heavy I can't lift them anymore... Hauh?! M-My hips... they're giving out...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひい……
肩も
これ以上あがらんわい……
はうっ！？　
こ、
腰
が……
ピキッ
と……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Hey, I'm not such an old bat.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おい、
そこまでガタきてないわ。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Aha! Sono-chan, you've reacted! For this match... Iroha wins♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
苑ちゃん反応しちゃったね！
入れ替わり勝負、
いろはの勝ちー♪

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...So it was a match to you. Ah, Mari-chan, good morning~
text_block_list.orig_text:
……勝負だったのかよ。
あ、
真璃ちゃんお疲れ～

text_block_list.name: Mari
text_block_list.text: ...Hello.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……どうも。

text_block_list.name: Mari
text_block_list.text: ...A body swap match? That was some high quality acting... It felt so natural that I took it seriously for a moment.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……入れ替わり勝負か。
クオリティ高いわね……
違和感なさ過ぎて
一瞬本気にしちゃったわ。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Mari couldn't believe how natural Sono and Iroha's "body swap" felt.
text_block_list.orig_text:
苑といろはの入れ替わりごっこの違和感のなさに
驚いてしまう真璃だった。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe they really were like that in a past life, too.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……なんて前世もあったのかもしれない。
